items.title: 【自荐】OmniConvert — 免费在线文件/单位转换工具（100%客户端处理）
items.author: s87343472
items.summary: OmniConvert 一个免费的在线文件格式和单位转换工具，所有转换在浏览器本地完成，不上传任何文件到服务器。 网站： 功能 94种文件转换 — 图片(JPG/PNG/WebP/HEIC/AVIF...)、音频(MP3/WAV/FLAC/AAC...)、视频(MP4/WebM/MOV/AVI/MKV→互转+GIF)、文档(PDF/Markdown)、数据(CSV/Excel/JSON) 345种单位换算 — 长度、重量、温度、面积、体积等13个类别，NIST标准精度 100%客户端处理 — 基于Canvas API、FFmpeg.wasm、pdf.js、SheetJS等，零服务器上传 8种语言 — 英/中/日/西/韩/葡/法/德 PWA支持 — 可离线使用 完全免费 — 无广告、无注册、无限制 技术栈 Astro 4.x + React + Tailwind CSS，部署在 Cloudflare Pages（免费套餐） GitHub: 为什么做这个 市面上的文件转换工具（CloudConvert、Zamzar等）都需要上传文件到服务器。对于注重隐私的用户来说，这是个问题。OmniConvert 让所有转换都在浏览器里完成，文件不离开你的设备。
items.content:
## OmniConvert

一个免费的在线文件格式和单位转换工具，**所有转换在浏览器本地完成，不上传任何文件到服务器**。

网站：[https://tools.sagasu.art/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=awesome-list&utm_campaign=ruanyf-weekly](https://tools.sagasu.art/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=awesome-list&utm_campaign=ruanyf-weekly)

## 功能

- **94种文件转换** — 图片(JPG/PNG/WebP/HEIC/AVIF...)、音频(MP3/WAV/FLAC/AAC...)、视频(MP4/WebM/MOV/AVI/MKV→互转+GIF)、文档(PDF/Markdown)、数据(CSV/Excel/JSON)
- **345种单位换算** — 长度、重量、温度、面积、体积等13个类别，NIST标准精度
- **100%客户端处理** — 基于Canvas API、FFmpeg.wasm、pdf.js、SheetJS等，零服务器上传
- **8种语言** — 英/中/日/西/韩/葡/法/德
- **PWA支持** — 可离线使用
- **完全免费** — 无广告、无注册、无限制

## 技术栈

Astro 4.x + React + Tailwind CSS，部署在 Cloudflare Pages（免费套餐）

GitHub: [https://github.com/s87343472/omni-convert](https://github.com/s87343472/omni-convert)

## 为什么做这个

市面上的文件转换工具（CloudConvert、Zamzar等）都需要上传文件到服务器。对于注重隐私的用户来说，这是个问题。OmniConvert 让所有转换都在浏览器里完成，文件不离开你的设备。

items.title: 【开源自荐】All API Hub —— 一站式管理 New API 等中转站账号
items.author: qixing-jk
items.summary: 项目地址： 📖 介绍 现在 AI 生态里有越来越多基于 New API 系列的聚合中转站和自建面板，要查看各站点的余额和模型列表，并管理和快速使用API 密钥，往往既分散又费时。 All API Hub 作为浏览器扩展，一站式管理 New API 等中转站账号：余额/用量看板、自动签到、密钥一键导出到常用应用、网页内 API 可用性测试、渠道与模型同步/重定向。当前已支持基于以下项目的中转站账号： oneapi newapi Veloera onehub donehub Sub2API（基本功能支持） NeoAPI（闭源） SuperAPI（闭源） RIXAPI（闭源，基本功能支持） VoAPI（闭源，老版本支持） ✨ 功能特性 🔍 智能站点识别 登录后粘贴站点地址即可添加账号，自动识别站点名称、充值比例等信息；识别失败可手动补录，并会提示重复添加。 👥 多账号总览面板 把多个站点与账号集中在一个面板里，余额、用量与健康状态一眼看清，并支持自动刷新数据。 📆 自动签到 识别支持签到的站点并集中处理，支持自动签到与执行记录，避免忘记签到浪费额度。 🔑 令牌与密钥管理 集中查看、复制和批量管理 API Key，减少来回切站点后台。 🤖 模型信息与价格 查看站点模型列表与价格信息，方便查看和对比可用模型与成本差异。 🧪 模型与接口验证 对指定密钥与模型做可用性验证，并提供 CLI 兼容性检查，适合排查“看起来能用但在工具中使用失败”的情况。 📊 用量分析与可视化 面向多站点/多账号的用量报表：按站点、账号、Token、日期筛选与对比，查看用量、花费、模型分布与趋势，并提供延迟与慢请求视图辅助排查。 🚀 快速导出集成 一键导出到 CherryStudio、CC Switch、CLIProxyAPI、Claude Code Router、New API 和 Veloera 等常用工具，减少复制粘贴与重复配置。 🔄 自建 New API 、 Veloera 和 Octopus 管理 面向自建 New API 、 Veloera 和 Octopus 的站点管理员，提供一键创建渠道、渠道管理、模型同步与模型重定向等工具，减少频繁进后台操作。 🖥️ 截图展示

items.content: ## 一句话描述 一站式信息管理工作台，通过采集 → 解读 → 沉淀 → 复用，让高质量内容真正变成可持续资产。 Github：https://github.com/shawnxie94/lumina 演示站点：https://lumina.shawnxie.top/ ## 核心功能 - **浏览器采集工作流**：支持全文/选区一键采集（弹窗与右键菜单），并内置最近采集与错误日志。 - **结构化文章库管理**：支持按分类、作者、来源、时间等高级筛选，并提供批量操作能力。 - **深度阅读体验**：详情页支持原文/译文切换、沉浸模式、目录导航、批注与评论。 - **AI 解读流水线**：可生成摘要、大纲、要点、翻译与相关文章推荐，后台任务支持监控与重试。 - **后台控制中心**：集中管理模型 API（通用/向量）、提示词、推荐策略、分类与站点配置。 - **运维与可观测能力**：提供 AI 任务与调用计量（次数/Tokens/费用）以及评论状态监控。 - **内容生命周期管理**：支持本地媒体存储/压缩/清理，以及 JSON 备份导出与增量导入恢复。 - **多语言与权限模型**：内置中英文界面，支持访客浏览与管理员鉴权管理流程。 ## 页面截图 ### 1) 主页 ### 2) 列表页 ### 3) 文章详情页 - **普通模式（默认）**：显示/编辑原文、全文批注、划线批注、目录、AI 解读和推荐阅读等。 - **沉浸模式**：宽屏模式，隐藏导航栏，专注于文章内容。 ### 4) 管理后台 - **监控模块**：支持模型调用记录/计费、AI任务和评论数据监控。 - **设置模块**：支持基础、分类、AI、评论和文件存储等配置。 ### 5) 扩展插件 - **全文一键采集**：不选中内容，点击插件采集按钮或页面右键采集。 - **选区一键采集**：选中内容后，点击插件采集按钮或页面右键采集。 ### 6) 其他功能 - **主题切换**：支持明亮/暗黑模式。 - **最近阅读记录**：显示最近阅读的5篇内容，方便快速跳转。 - **文章评论**：支持在详情页对文章进行评论，方便交流与反馈。 - **内容导出**：支持按分类导出文章标题、头图和摘要。

items.summary: 项目地址 类别 JS 项目标题 100%浏览器端运行的文件格式转换和单位换算工具，隐私安全无上传 项目描述 OmniConvert 是一个完全在浏览器端运行的文件格式和单位换算工具。支持94种文件转换（图片、音频、视频、PDF、文档、表格）和345种单位换算，覆盖13个类别。所有处理在本地完成，文件不会上传到服务器。支持8种语言和PWA离线使用。基于 Astro + React + FFmpeg.wasm + pdf.js 构建，部署在 Cloudflare Pages。 亮点 1. 🔒 100%客户端处理：所有文件转换都在浏览器中完成，文件永远不会离开用户设备，真正的隐私保护 2. 📦 覆盖面广：94种文件转换 + 345种单位换算，一个工具覆盖日常几乎所有转换需求 3. 🌍 8种语言：中/英/日/韩/法/德/西/葡，国际化做得很完善 4. 📱 PWA离线支持：安装后无需网络即可使用，适合离线场景 5. ⚡ 无需注册：打开即用，完全免费，无广告，无使用限制 6. 🛠️ 技术栈现代：Astro + React + FFmpeg.wasm + pdf.js，对前端开发者学习 WASM 在浏览器端的应用有参考价值 示例代码 截图或演示视频 在线体验： !OmniConvert Screenshot 声明：我是该项目的作者。

items.title: Termsy
items.summary: Scans terms and conditions for you
items.content: Termsy automatically scans Terms of Service and Privacy Policy pages, highlights critical clauses, and presents them in a clean sidebar. It helps you make an informed choice, before agreeing. It's fast, lightweight & easy to use. Comes in dark and light modes.

items.title: Amerta
items.summary: Headless e-commerce platform built on PayloadCMS & NextJS
items.content: Amerta is a headless e-commerce platform built on PayloadCMS, offering Next.js storefronts, a type-safe API, and total creative freedom for developers.

items.title: Seedance 2.0
items.summary: Seedance 2.0 - AI Video Generation Platform
items.content: Create stunning AI-generated videos with Seedance 2.0. Transform your ideas into professional-quality videos using advanced AI technology.

items.title: Zerosum
items.summary: Zero-based budgeting that makes sense
items.content: Zerosum is a zero-based budgeting app built for people who want a clear plan before they spend. We use the same give-every-dollar-a-job method, but with a simpler workflow and lower pricing. Basic is $40/year and includes unlimited budgets/accounts, goals, analytics, recurring + split transactions, loan tracking, and keyboard-first shortcuts. You can also invite up to 5 members on one subscription and import your full YNAB history. Pro with automatic bank sync is coming soon.

items.title: Ocean Anticheat
items.summary: Forensic cheat detection in under a minute.
items.content: Ocean Anti-Cheat is a professional screenshare and cheat detection tool for gaming communities. Scan suspects in 60 seconds with advanced forensic analysis, military-grade encryption, and real-time threat detection. Trusted by 500+ servers for FiveM, Minecraft, and +10 more games. Free tier available.

items.title: UXMagic.ai
items.summary: AI UX/UI Tool for Production-Ready Wireframes & UI
items.content: UXMagic is an AI-powered UX/UI design tool that transforms text prompts, screenshots, sketches, and URLs into structured wireframes, connected user flows, and production-ready UI layouts. Unlike tools that create disconnected screens, it focuses on UX logic, layout hierarchy, and design consistency. Built for startups and product teams, UXMagic supports rapid prototyping, MVP development, scalable design systems, and seamless Figma integration for real-world product workflows.

items.title: Market Lab
items.summary: Realistic backtests platform
items.content: A free, realistic backtesting platform built for traders who care about execution accuracy. Unlike most tools, it focuses on realistic candles, custom timeframes, and behavior that mirrors live markets—helping traders find real edge (or discard bad ideas) before risking real money.

items.title: Console
items.summary: Identify Risk in Your Cold Email List Before You Send
items.content: Console provides pre-send email validation for businesses and teams. We help identify risky email addresses before you send, using transparent checks like syntax, MX records, and domain signals — without sending emails or probing mailboxes.

items.title: LocalAICheck
items.summary: AI is the new Google. See if your business shows up!
items.content: Customers don't just Google anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini for "best plumber near me" or "good coffee shop downtown." AI only recommends 3 to 5 businesses. There's no page two. LocalAICheck makes this new kind of SEO simple. Enter your business, get a plain-English report: where you rank, who AI recommends instead, and exactly what to fix, in order of impact. No marketing degree needed. Built for the shop owner. Invite Code: "SupportLocalBiz"

items.title: Slopify
items.summary: Music for no one, by AI
items.content: The world's first fully AI-generated music streaming platform. Artists? Fake. Music? Synthetic. Artwork? Hallucinated. Bio's? Imaginary. Codebase? Should be burned at the stake. Algorithmic noise pretending to be culture. And somehow... it slaps. Slopify. Where the future of music goes to become soup.

items.title: InterviewPilot
items.summary: Practice real coding interviews with AI feedback
items.content: Ace your tech interviews with AI-powered mock interviews. Practice DSA and behavioral questions from FAANG companies. Get instant feedback and detailed performance reports. Start practicing for free!

items.title: Skyfarer Academy
items.summary: Connects pilots with instructors, schools, services and more
items.content: Search, compare, and connect with certified flight instructors (CFIs), flight schools, aviation professionals, aircraft services, and pilot gear — near your preferred U.S. airport or by name. Find the right support for your flying journey, all in one place.

items.title: WikiTrip 2.0
items.summary: Location-based audio guide powered by Wikipedia
items.content: WikiTrip is an app that reads out interesting Wikipedia articles around you. Perfect for roadtrips, daily commutes or city trips. Learn about the world around you!

items.title: Wardstone
items.summary: Guard your AI from prompt attacks, harmful content, and PII
items.content: Wardstone is an LLM security API that detects prompt injections, jailbreaks, harmful content, and data leakage in a single call with sub-30ms latency. It works as a firewall between your app and any LLM provider, scanning both inputs and outputs. Drop-in REST API with SDKs for TypeScript, Python, Go, Ruby, PHP, Java, and C#. Four detection categories with risk bands out of the box. Free tier with 10,000 calls/month, no credit card needed. Start protecting your AI in minutes.

items.title: Profit Scanner
items.summary: Bulk scan supplier lists and find the best products to sell
items.content: Upload any supplier price list and instantly see which products are profitable on Amazon. Real Keepa data, not estimates. What makes us different: AI Autopilot auto-filters unprofitable products 100+ data points per product (competitors: 75-80) 9 risk detection types (IP, HAZMAT, bundles, meltable) Confidence scoring shows data reliability 10 Amazon marketplaces in one scan Built for Amazon wholesale sellers. Free plan available.

items.title: Couples Questions Games
items.summary: Stronger relationships with quizzes & questions
items.content: ✨ A free couples app for quick, playful sessions 🧩 Pick a quiz category, answer separately, and see how well you match 💬 Switch to question decks for a guided talk (fun → deep) 📵 No accounts, no feeds — just you two

items.title: OneCritto
items.summary: OneCritto — Offline password & file manager. No cloud. Ever.
items.content: OneCritto is truly offline. No cloud, no accounts, no servers. Passwords and files are encrypted and stored only on your device. One-time purchase, no subscriptions. Built for users who want full control, not cloud dependency.

items.title: Dari
items.summary: Instant global payments with stablecoins
items.content: Dari is a next-generation global payments platform powered by stablecoins. Send and receive money instantly across borders with full KYC/AML compliance, 24/7 availability, and low fees. Built for individuals and businesses who need fast, secure, and transparent international transfers without traditional banking delays.

items.title: Enviro Test Transport
items.summary: Environmental safety for transport systems
items.content: EnviroTestTransport offers testing and monitoring solutions tailored for public and private transportation networks. From air quality in buses and trains to contamination checks in logistics hubs, we help operators safeguard passengers, employees, and cargo.

items.title: Catomize
items.summary: Real-time data sync to grow e-commerce revenue
items.content: What differentiates us most is our event-driven architecture. While most platforms rely on cache layers and scheduled batch syncs, we stream inventory and catalog updates instantly across all systems. No stale cache, no delayed polling — just real-time truth. Catomize acts as a system-level data integrity layer, eliminating phantom inventory, overselling, and performance trade-offs at scale.
